mapper.select: select distinct p.id, p.parent_id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.path, p.icon, p.sort_order, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id inner join sys_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and p.status = 'ACTIVE' order by p.sort_order, p.id
